subject.title: fix(gateway): honor scopes for WebChat session mutations

question: Does the centralized Gateway method-scope policy intentionally provide complete authorization for every WebChat session mutation whose identity-based guard this PR removes?
rationale: The branch changes an authorization boundary across destructive and stateful session operations; the protected labels require a human to confirm that scope mapping, rather than client identity, is the intended security contract.

options.title: Approve the scope-only contract
options.body: Confirm that the method-scope registry and parameter-aware patch/delete rules are the complete intended authorization policy, then merge with the included integration coverage.

options.title: Retain an explicit additional restriction
options.body: Define and document any required non-spoofable client-class restriction, then revise the implementation and tests to enforce that contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the scope-only contract
recommendation.body: Confirm that the method-scope registry and parameter-aware patch/delete rules are the complete intended authorization policy, then merge with the included integration coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The paired issue records the proposed authorization model and its expected security boundary.
